notes.title: New Upcoming Release!
notes.notes:
Hey Ghostist Players,

I hope you're all doing great! It's been an amazing journey since the release of Ghostist, and I can't thank you enough for your support. Your enthusiasm and feedback have been invaluable.

I'm excited to share that I've been working on a new game called "Housekeeping To Room 501". This casual horror game dives into mind-bending liminal spaces within a haunted old hotel. Your task is to clean the hotel while avoiding its otherworldly inhabitants. You can find more details on the Steam page: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3307410/Housekeeping_to_Room_501/


I wanted to give you a heads-up about the upcoming release because I think you might like it.
Wishlisting the game would be a BIG help! 

Thank you once again for being such an amazing community. Your support means the world to me, and I can't wait to hear your thoughts on "Housekeeping To Room 501"! And if you're interested in creating some prerelease videos - don't hesitate to contact me!

Best, 
taxicomics

notes.title: Update 1.8
notes.notes:
Hello Players!
This month has been quite busy on the boring side of things, a lot bureaucracy behind the scenes kept me from developing the game further. But I don't want to bore you with that, so here are the new things/changes:


new ghost behaviour! The ghosts articulations have been reworked, sometimes you have to deal with little ghost girls, sometimes you have to deal with big ghost boys. Enjoy!
new ghost model was added along with some animations
rearranged the EMF (sorry)
made the toilet a little less prone to flushing

notes.title: The "Welcome Back!"-Update
notes.notes:
Reading and hearing your feedback was the greatest part of this last week. And it has inspired me to make another update for Ghostist. 
Let's start with what you came here for:

What has changed?
- new music was added and some old music was cut
- the activity levels of different ghosts should now better reflect their personality
- gave the GIC some common sense ( I´d like some feedback on that )
- removed the social links
- fixed some noise-bugs
- changed some item prices(you get to keep your saved items though)
- made toilets flushable 

These might seem like rather minor changes, but under the hood a lot has changed. And it enables future features that I won't discuss just yet. This is not meant as a "Horse Armor DLC"(comment if you got that reference) but rather as a "Hey, I'm still here and I'm so happy that you are, too!"-Update. But that was too long a title, so Welcome Back!-Update it is. 

Once again, I'm really happy you're here, and I hope you enjoy your time with Ghostist. I love watching you play my game :)

notes.title: The "Exorcist" - Update
notes.notes:
NEW LATEGAME CONTENT
This is a very experimental update. Every bit of feedback is highly appreciated!


 Ghosts were always able to hunt you, but now you can hunt back! Buy the Exorcismkit and banish the ghosts! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39868648/8bf0de5f960406e633bccf9ce67f859fe5022ecd.png
 in order to banish ghosts you first need to be sure what type of ghost you are dealing with. And be absolutely sure! No ghost likes being taunted. 

 Collect all the bones scattered across the level.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39868648/9d2f80336a190f8149b4e07c5fc99dbdf008f962.png

 Draw the correct symbol for each ghost
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39868648/dd21421e07837ce2c696ad1ded9885069349102c.png.

Ghosts can break your bones

 aggressive ghosts will now break your bones to make your escape a little harder. Stock up on Medkits (new item!)


various small stuff

 nerfed the emf more, so now you need to be around the ghost longer
 improved lamps a little bit
 added the TV
 various tiny map changes
 lots of sound changes


Have fun <3

notes.title: The "Yes, this gets updated a lot"-Update
notes.notes:
A Few Words
This game has been out for just a few days and i could not be happier. Thanks for the feedback and everybody reaching out, it means a lot. I sadly had to work in my real life job a lot, but don´t worry, i´m still hard at work developing GHOSTIST further. Thanks for sharing the early-access lifestyle with me!

What is new?

 changed emf to red emf on ghost identification chart(thanks ASHZBASHZ)
 made the Ghost Identification Chart agGressive(thanks VertigoCharades)
 added coffeemachine with the first base upgrade
 added another base level(pun?)
 included autosave(yay for convenience, nay for the closed loophole of just reloading after dying)
 made ravesticks glowier(thanks VertigoCharades)
 made smokebombs last longer(thanks VertigoCharades)
 new painting

 nerfed a really good joke

notes.title: The Faster Better Stronger Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39868648/a3da5d2112656f45ea07fafff898b81a81c48d04.png

This is a lot, so brace yourself

We were hard at work and reworked a lot of the game based on your feedback. The artist did a wonderful job tweaking lots of big and small stuff. Let´s get started:

Gameplay

 Big Ghost-B-Gone Changes, it is now a much more important tool. All ghosts emit EMF's, but only some reach the tip of the scale
 Added the "expert guess" bonus for experienced hunters. If you have not yet experienced an effect but think you know which ghost you are dealing with you get a bonus if you´re right
 Ghosts really hate cross breezes now and are eager to close open doors
 Ghosts hate being constricted. That means less being stuck but also less catching the ghost with salt. Ghosts will now try to free themselves after some time
 changed cheats


Items

 Added coffee! Use it for big maps or just to increase your blood pressure


Maps

 Lots of big and small map changes, some changing features, some just adding bathrooms
 Added a new map! 


Art

 Reworked the tools in small and big ways, most prominent changes to the spirit box
 Lots of new bathroom stuff
 some new furniture
 changed the shadows
 added more lamps


General

 small bugfixes
 got first hatemail
 got lots of very nice mail too!
 got excited for release on Tuesday

notes.title: Feature Complete Version Is Out!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39868648/5194b5fdd4ecbaf4a3a877cddd2266baa106e665.gif
Hello dear paranormal friends! 
I know you have become great ghostists on your journey through the betaphase of this game. Now it´s time to really get to work. There is a lot of new stuff here, so strap in:

What is new?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39868648/e8e2e481c97007e0d33b58c38f2a5f89c943e210.png

 added a new level
 added new control scheme
 rebalanced everything(but you beta testers get to keep your saves and all that money)
 changed the glowsticks a lot - they are now a toy ghosts enjoy to hate
 improved ghost hunting and wandering AI
 added statistics so you can keep track of your progress
 added upgrades to your base (earn 'em by doing a good job)
 added cheats for development but left them in for fun-try to find them!
 got real happy
 improved existing maps
 got the nicest betatesters in the world


What got fixed?

 had a talk with ghosts about their trips into walls(thanks corestrategy!)
 made the flashlight stop bending the laws of physics
 made the ghosts a little less snackish
 stopped the tutorial from invading missions(thanks michael and corestrategy!)
 got rid of the foggy indoors(thanks, yusuf!)


What now?
We´re very happy about this v1.0 release, every planned feature is now implemented. Now you, the community, can help to sculpt new ideas and give your feedback so more people can enjoy Ghostist :)


If you have any problems don´t hesitate to contact us via Instagram or our Subreddit r/Ghostist.
There is one week left before release (2nd of March, next Tuesday), that should be enough time to discover and fix potential bugs. 
Thanks for your support so far, you´re really what kept me going,
taxicomics
